quarantine.description: If a quarantine label/xattr was applied or cleared.

label.description: Opaque filesystem metadata pointer/cache for current quarantine state; not the authoritative provenance record.

execution.description: Execution boundary used for import/open work.

post_detach_capability_mode_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether post-detach later-tool code ran only after capability mode entry.

post_detach_late_path_open_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether ambient late path opens remained unavailable after capability mode entry.

post_detach_descriptor_set_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the later worker inherited only the reviewed descriptor set.

post_detach_stdio_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether stdio stayed launcher-owned and non-parent-session-shaped.

post_detach_environment_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the later worker inherited only a reviewed minimal environment.

post_detach_argv_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether worker argv came from a reviewed launcher template rather than media-derived arguments.

post_detach_cwd_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the later worker cwd was launcher-owned scratch rather than inherited path authority.

post_detach_executable_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the later worker executable was launcher-resolved and digest-pinned rather than PATH/cwd/media-derived.

post_detach_executable_locator.description: Optional reviewed locator for the post-detach executable selected by the launcher.

post_detach_executable_digest.description: Optional digest of the post-detach executable selected by the launcher.

post_detach_wrapper_contract_digest.description: Optional digest of the wrapper contract binding executable identity to launch context and preopens.

post_detach_helper_discovery_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether helper/plugin discovery stayed disabled or explicitly wrapper-brokered.

post_detach_runtime_dependency_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the later worker runtime dependency closure is launcher-pinned rather than ambient-loader-selected.

post_detach_runtime_dependency_closure_d.description: Optional digest of the post-detach runtime dependency closure selected by the launcher.

post_detach_dynamic_loader_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether dynamic loader/library path inputs stayed out of the first lane.

post_detach_credential_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the later worker credential envelope is launcher-fixed, unprivileged, and free of supplementary groups.

post_detach_worker_user.description: Optional reviewed worker user/principal label for the post-detach later worker.

post_detach_worker_group.description: Optional reviewed worker group label for the post-detach later worker.

post_detach_supplementary_groups_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether supplementary groups are absent from the later worker credential envelope.

post_detach_privilege_regain_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether setuid/setgid/saved-id or ambient privilege regain paths are unavailable.

post_detach_process_lifecycle_posture.description: Optional posture string that records whether the post-detach worker lifecycle is launcher-supervised and daemon-free.

post_detach_descendant_posture.description: Optional posture string that records whether background descendants or unreviewed subprocesses remain outside the first lane.

post_detach_reap_posture.description: Optional posture string that records whether the launcher reaps the entire worker process tree before authoritative derivative receipt.

post_detach_worker_exit_posture.description: Optional posture string recording that worker exit was observed before the derivative receipt became authoritative.

post_detach_resource_envelope_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the post-detach worker runs inside a launcher-enforced resource envelope.

post_detach_resource_receipt_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the resource envelope and observed usage are receipt-visible.

post_detach_resource_failure_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether resource-limit violations fail closed without derivative authority.

post_detach_output_bound_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether declared derivative output bytes are bounded before receipt authority.

post_detach_resource_limits.description: Optional reviewed resource envelope for the post-detach removable-media later worker.

post_detach_observed_resource_usage.description: Optional observed usage for the post-detach removable-media later worker resource envelope.

post_detach_peer_interaction_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the post-detach worker is isolated from ambient peer ptrace, signal, IPC, and procfs control/observation.

post_detach_peer_interaction_receipt_pos.description: Optional posture string recording whether peer-isolation and signal-control policy must be receipt-visible.

post_detach_signal_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether signal/control authority stays launcher-only.

post_detach_ipc_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether unreviewed IPC surfaces stay out of the first lane.

post_detach_procfs_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether procfs, ptrace, and ktrace are unavailable to the worker and ambient peers.

post_detach_ambient_input_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether post-detach ambient host inputs are launcher-sealed rather than worker-read authority.

post_detach_ambient_input_receipt_postur.description: Optional posture string recording whether the ambient-input envelope and launcher-owned timestamps are receipt-visible.

post_detach_clock_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether wall-clock, timezone, and calendar reads are excluded from derivative authority.

post_detach_randomness_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether worker randomness or host entropy are excluded from derivative input authority.

post_detach_host_identity_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether hostname, kernel/sysctl, locale, and machine identity are excluded from derivative authority.

post_detach_network_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether post-detach network egress is absent and no socket/DNS/remote-callback authority is admitted.

post_detach_network_receipt_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the no-network envelope is receipt-visible.

post_detach_name_resolution_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether DNS, mDNS, NSS, resolver, and host-name-service inputs stay out of derivative authority.

post_detach_proxy_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether proxy and remote-service configuration are absent from the post-detach worker.

post_detach_remote_dependency_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether remote fetches, callbacks, telemetry, update checks, and remote service dependencies are not derivative authority.

post_detach_persistent_state_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether the post-detach worker ran without durable user-home/cache/config/history or host-state write authority.

post_detach_persistent_state_receipt_pos.description: Optional posture string recording whether persistent-state absence and scratch cleanup are receipt-visible.

post_detach_scratch_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether worker scratch is launcher-created, empty, per-run, bounded, and nonauthoritative.

post_detach_scratch_cleanup_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether scratch cleanup completes before derivative receipt authority.

post_detach_cache_config_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether user-home, cache, config, state, history, and profile stores are excluded from derivative authority.

post_detach_contract_closure_posture.description: Optional posture string recording that the post-detach first-lane contract is schema-backed and protected by positive plus negative fixtures.

post_detach_contract_digest.description: Optional digest of the reviewed post-detach contract closure object.

post_detach_backend_evidence_posture.description: Optional posture string recording that FreeBSD launch/enforcement evidence must be bound to the receipt instead of asserted by prose.

post_detach_negative_fixture_policy.description: Optional posture string recording that known-bad authority shapes must fail validation before the lane is considered closed.

post_detach_launch_evidence_posture.description: Optional posture string recording that FreeBSD post-detach launch evidence is typed, positive-fixture validated, and red-fixture guarded.

post_detach_launch_evidence_digest.description: Optional digest of the reviewed post-detach FreeBSD launch evidence object.

post_detach_launch_evidence_schema.description: Optional schema path for the post-detach FreeBSD launch evidence object.

post_detach_launch_evidence_negative_fix.description: Optional policy string recording that known-bad FreeBSD launch evidence shapes must fail validation.

post_detach_recovery_evidence_posture.description: Optional posture string recording whether post-detach recovery evidence is typed and red-fixture guarded.

post_detach_recovery_evidence_digest.description: Optional digest of the post-detach recovery evidence object.

post_detach_recovery_evidence_schema.description: Optional schema path for post-detach recovery evidence.

post_detach_recovery_evidence_negative_f.description: Optional red-corpus policy for post-detach recovery evidence.

post_detach_recovery_evidence_required.description: Optional marker that derivative receipt visibility waits for valid recovery evidence.

outputs.description: Imported outputs and any explicitly retained preserved-capture artifacts.

role.description: Optional role of this output within the import lane.

source_digest.description: Digest of the preserved source artifact when this output is a later derivative.

relationship.description: Optional relationship to the preserved source artifact, for example derived-from-captured-subject.

locator_kind.description: Stable locator class for the authoritative stored artifact when applicable.

locator.description: Stable authoritative locator for the preserved artifact when applicable.

projection_path.description: Optional worker-local execution path for a read-only projection of the authoritative stored artifact.

projection_scope.description: Optional statement of how much worker-visible namespace the projection exposes, for example single-preserved-subject-only.

locator_visibility.description: Optional statement of whether the authoritative locator is receipt-only evidence or directly exposed in the worker namespace.

projection_source_digest.description: Digest of the preserved source artifact that the worker-visible projection/handle is bound to when applicable.

projection_binding_posture.description: Optional statement that the worker-visible delivery is digest-bound to the preserved capture before later ops begin.

projection_binding_evidence.description: Optional statement of how the receipt records the projection-to-source digest binding.

projection_delivery_posture.description: Optional statement that the worker-visible delivery is launcher-preopened read-only or equivalent before later ops begin.

projection_reopen_posture.description: Optional statement that later worker execution does not reacquire the preserved subject through broader path/store reopen.

worker_output_path.description: Optional worker-local disposable outbox path where a later derivative was emitted before broker collection.

worker_output_slot_id.description: Optional declared writable derivative slot id that the authoritative later-worker derivative was collected from.

worker_output_slot_scope.description: Optional statement that the first lane admits only one declared writable derivative slot.

worker_output_extra_surface_posture.description: Optional statement that extra worker result surface stays out in this lane and receipt-visible derivatives must come from the declared slot.

worker_output_authority_posture.description: Optional statement that the worker-visible outbox path is execution evidence only and not authoritative derivative identity.

collection_posture.description: Optional statement that later-worker derivative bytes were broker-collected and remeasured before the receipt named an authoritative locator.

delivery_posture.description: Optional statement that the later worker wrote derivative bytes only to launcher-precreated sink objects or equivalent bounded outbox delivery.

worker_output_initialization_posture.description: Optional statement that the later-worker declared derivative slot started as a launcher-precreated empty regular file.

worker_output_io_posture.description: Optional statement that the later-worker derivative slot stayed append-open/forward-only with no readback or truncate authority.

worker_output_open_posture.description: Optional statement that the later-worker derivative sink was launcher-preopened O_APPEND or equivalent before worker execution.

worker_output_append_protection_posture.description: Optional statement that the later-worker derivative sink stayed append-only-protected during worker execution.

worker_output_seek_posture.description: Optional statement that any CAP_SEEK on a seekable regular-file sink exists as implementation ballast rather than rewrite authority.

metadata.description: How provenance/quarantine metadata was preserved, rehydrated, or degraded for this import result.

authority.description: Accepted v0 model: content.origin in CAS is authoritative; filesystem label is a local pointer/cache.

transport.description: How metadata reached the imported result.

status.description: Whether origin/quarantine metadata survived intact, was rebuilt from an authoritative record, or appears to have been stripped.

authoritative_origin_digest.description: Digest of the authoritative content.origin record for this import subject.
